scripts.skills:sync: node -e "const{execFileSync}=require('node:child_process'),fs=require('node:fs'),os=require('node:os'),p=require('node:path'),c=require('node:crypto');const F='skills-lock.json',L=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(F,'utf8')),S=L.skills||{},A=process.argv.slice(1),U=A.includes('--update'),V=A.includes('--verify'),T=['.agents/skills','.claude/skills'];T.forEach(t=>fs.mkdirSync(t,{recursive:true}));const hash=d=>{const f=[],walk=(x,b)=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(x,{withFileTypes:true})){if(e.name==='.git')continue;const r=b?b+'/'+e.name:e.name;e.isDirectory()?walk(p.join(x,e.name),r):f.push(r)}};walk(d,'');f.sort();const g=c.createHash('sha256');for(const r of f){g.update(r);g.update('\0');g.update(fs.readFileSync(p.join(d,r)));g.update('\0')}return g.digest('hex')};const repos={};let dirty=false,bad=0;for(const n of Object.keys(S).sort()){const e=S[n];if(e.sourceType!=='github'){console.log('[skip] '+n+' ('+e.sourceType+')');continue}if(!repos[e.source]){const t=fs.mkdtempSync(p.join(os.tmpdir(),'skills-'));execFileSync('git',['clone','--depth=1','--quiet','https://github.com/'+e.source+'.git',t],{stdio:['ignore','ignore','inherit']});repos[e.source]=t}const root=repos[e.source],src=(e.path?[e.path]:['skills/'+n,n,'.claude/skills/'+n,'.agents/skills/'+n]).map(x=>p.join(root,x)).find(x=>fs.existsSync(x));if(!src){console.error('[fail] '+n+': not found in '+e.source);bad++;continue}const h=hash(src);if(!e.computedHash||U&&e.computedHash!==h){e.computedHash=h;dirty=true}else if(e.computedHash!==h){bad++;console.error('[hash] '+n+': lock '+e.computedHash.slice(0,12)+' actual '+h.slice(0,12))}if(!V)for(const t of T){const d=p.join(t,n);fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync(src,d,{recursive:true})}console.log('[ok] '+n+' <- '+e.source+(e.path?':'+e.path:''))}for(const t of Object.values(repos))fs.rmSync(t,{recursive:true,force:true});if(dirty&&!V){fs.writeFileSync(F,JSON.stringify(L,null,2)+'\n');console.log('[lock] '+F+' updated')}if(bad){console.error('[skills] '+bad+' problem(s); run: npm run skills:update');process.exit(1)}" --
scripts.skills:all: npm run skills:sync && npm run skills:impeccable && npm run skills:ide
scripts.mcp:check: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.mcp.json','utf8')).mcpServers;const o=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('opencode.json','utf8')).mcp||{};const key=c=>(c.type==='http'?['remote',c.url]:['local',c.command,...(c.args||[])]).join(' ');const keyO=c=>(c.type==='remote'?['remote',c.url]:['local',...(c.command||[])]).join(' ');const bad=[];for(const k of Object.keys(m)){if(!o[k]){bad.push(k+': falta en opencode.json');continue}const a=key(m[k]),b=keyO(o[k]);if(a===b)continue;const strip=s=>s.split(' ').filter(x=>!x.startsWith('--executablePath')&&!x.includes('CHROME_PATH')).join(' ');if(strip(a)===strip(b))continue;bad.push(k+' | .mcp.json: '+a+' | opencode.json: '+b)}for(const k of Object.keys(o))if(!m[k])bad.push(k+': sobra en opencode.json');if(bad.length){console.error('[mcp:check] divergencias:');bad.forEach(b=>console.error('  '+b));process.exit(1)}console.log('[mcp:check] '+Object.keys(m).length+' servidores MCP alineados entre .mcp.json y opencode.json')"
